categoryFlags._about: How each category's spending counts (REQUIREMENTS EXP-08; the proposed flags, owner 2026-11-12, Q27). A category without its own flag takes its parent's; one with neither is essential. Configuration, not code (PRD-05); the owner edits them in the app from M3.

settings._about: Settings defaults (REQUIREMENTS SET-04, CFG-02): backups kept (BAK-08), how often the passphrase is asked again (KEY-02), and the default stale-balance window in days (ACCT-02, final value Q15). Editable in the app from M2.

setupSteps._about: The in-app setup checklist (REQUIREMENTS SET-07, T241). One step per section of docs/setup/google-account-setup.md; item texts are its checklist lines without Markdown. A test keeps the two in step.

items.text: The account is new and used for SanthIQ only.
Its address and password are saved in the password manager.
2-Step Verification is on, with a passkey or an authenticator app, and a backup method.
The recovery email is your personal Gmail.

steps.title: Forward bank mail from your Gmail

items.text: The app's address is added as a forwarding address and confirmed from the app's inbox.
Disable forwarding is still selected, so all-mail forwarding is off.
The filter's From box holds exactly the sender list the app shows.
The filter's only action is Forward it to the app's address; nothing is deleted, archived or kept out of your inbox.
After the next bank email: the copy is in the app's inbox, from the bank's own address, with the same date and text, and any attachment present.

steps.title: Copy your documents into the app's Drive

items.text: My documents are copied into SanthIQ/Documents, each in its category, country and person or item folder.
Statement PDFs are in SanthIQ/Inbox, not in Documents.
No folder holds a password, PIN, card photo, CVV or one-time code.
My originals are still in my own Drive; nothing there was moved or deleted.
Your calendar is shared with the app's address with See all event details, nothing more.
Signed in as the app's account, Google Calendar shows your events.

steps.title: Accept what the app shares back

items.text: The SanthIQ folder appears under Shared with me in your Drive.
You can add a file to Inbox, but not to Reports, Backups or Sync.
The SanthIQ reminders calendar shows in your calendar on the phone.
